 WTA Guangzhou Day 2 Predictions Including Venus Williams vs Lilli Tagger 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 The WTA Guangzhou first round is nearing its conclusion, with day two seeing a packed slate of matches, including the highly anticipated return of a legend in what will surely be her swansong on the Asian swing. As always, we here at LWOT will be offering our predictions for every match on the slate on day two, including Dayana Yastremska vs Katie Volynets and Sofia Kenin vs Kaitlin Quevedo . But who do you think will make the second round?
 WTA Guangzhou Day 2 Predictions
 Sun Xinran vs Mananchaya Sawangkaew
 Head-to-head: first meeting
 Given a main draw wildcard to play in front of her home fans at WTA Guangzhou, the #1-ranked junior player in the world, Sun Xinran, showed in her matches in Beijing why she has the potential to be successful on the pro tour as well. Against Mananchaya Sawangkaew, a player who has not won a main draw match since the US Open, this match will come down to how well the youngster can live up to the expectations on her. If she remains composed, her baseline game should be enough to get another WTA Tour win here.
 Prediction: Sun in 3 
 Polina Kudermetova vs Janice Tjen
 Head-to-head: First meeting
 This matchup pairs the aggressive game of Polina Kudermetova against the more tactical and slice-heavy game of Janice Tjen. The physical fitness level of Kudermetova coming into this match will be key, as she ended her tournament in Ningbo last week early due to injury. Tjen will look to drag this match out and use her variety to frustrate Kudermetova, keeping the Uzbek from settling into a rhythm and testing her movement. If she is successful in doing so, she should be able to win the match.
 Prediction: Tjen in 3 
 Venus Williams vs Lilli Tagger
 Head-to-head: First meeting
 It is entirely understndable why she was given a main draw wildcard at WTA Guangzhou, but we have reached a point when Venus Williams playing tennis is more of a celebration of her career than there being any real expectation that she will win. Her status as a legend of the sport is beyond question, but she lost 15 consecutive singles matches on tour without being particularly competitive. Up against Lilli Tagger, a young player on the rise, this also looks likely to be a challenge too far for Williams. In front of what will surely a packed crowd at WTA Guangzhou, expect Tagger to win.
 Prediction: Tagger in 2
